release_notes: Build 176 replaces the Instagram documentation-only setup link with a real Instagram Business Login connection flow.
Build 176 exchanges the Instagram authorization code for a long-lived access token and saves the token with the existing local protection mechanism.
Build 176 validates the connected Instagram account before handing control back to Autopilot and keeps the existing Facebook Page approval flow intact.
Build 176 keeps the deferred startup phases and reduced cleanup passes from the previous performance builds.
